title: feat(access): Studio Explain panel — package-scoped object dropdown (#2600 B2)
body:
## What

**Issue #2600 · B2 (设计迭代 · 解释访问权限面板)** — the *"why can this user access?"* panel asked for the object as **free text**, with a placeholder (`crm_lead`) that isn't even in the package. You had to know the exact api-name, and the example named a non-existent object. The Access pillar already knows its package (~20 objects).

### Changes
- `AccessExplainPanel` gains an optional **`packageId`**; when set it loads that package's objects (the same `list('object', {packageId})` the matrix uses) and renders the 对象 field as a **`<select>`** of `label (api-name)`.
- Free-text input stays as a **graceful fallback** (unscoped callers, or if the list fails to load).
- Placeholder no longer names a non-existent object (`对象名(如:crm_lead)` → `对象 API 名称`).
- `StudioDesignSurface` passes `packageId` to the panel.
- The Explain button was already correctly disabled (opacity-50) until an object is chosen — the dropdown just makes choosing one obvious.

## Verify (live, showcase backend)
- Open 解释访问权限 → 对象 is a dropdown with **22 options** (placeholder + 21 package objects, `客户 (showcase_account)` …), **no `crm_lead`**.
- 解释 button `disabled`/opacity-0.5 while empty → enabled/opacity-1 after selecting an object.

## Tests
`AccessExplainPanel.test.tsx`: dropdown renders package objects + posts the selected object; free-text fallback without a scope. Existing explain round-trip tests keep passing (added a `./useMetadata` mock). Panel suite + Studio guard suites (accessGuard/pillarNavGuard/emptyPackage): **23 tests green**.
